title: press state
name: Press state
rule: Always include a press state on a custom button so the control feels like it accepted input.
pass_when: Custom buttons have a press state that shows the control accepted input.
fail_when: Custom button has no press/active visual.
overview: Custom buttons include a press state that shows input was accepted.
apply_when: Building custom button visuals instead of native platform controls.
not_when: Native buttons that already provide press feedback from the platform.
agent_hint: Add a clear press or active visual on every custom button.
description: Custom buttons need a press or active visual so the control feels like it accepted input. Without that state, taps feel dead even when the underlying action runs, and people may press again. Rely on the platform’s built-in press treatment for native controls; add an explicit press look whenever you draw the button yourself. The press state is part of making interaction feel responsive, alongside hover and focus.
